questions.question: ___ Elephants are intelligent animals.
questions.explanation: Elephants refers to the entire class of animals, so the plural noun takes no article.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The teachers play an important role in society.
Teachers play an important role in society.
A teachers play an important role in society.
An teachers play an important role in society.
questions.correctAnswer: Teachers play an important role in society.
questions.explanation: Teachers is used in a general sense to refer to teachers as a group.

questions.question: ___ Smartphones have changed how people communicate.
questions.explanation: Smartphones refers to the category in general, so no article is needed.

questions.question: Which sentence refers to animals in general?
options: The lions in this zoo are sleeping.
The lions near the river are hungry.
The lions we saw yesterday were young.
questions.explanation: The plural noun 'lions' refers to the species in general. The other sentences identify particular lions.

questions.question: ___ Students should develop good study habits.
questions.explanation: Students is a plural countable noun used generally.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Trees is used to make a general statement about the class of trees.

questions.question: ___ Computers are useful tools for education.
questions.explanation: Computers refers to computers as a general category.

questions.question: Which sentence refers to a particular group rather than a general class?
options: The players wearing blue jerseys won the match.
questions.correctAnswer: The players wearing blue jerseys won the match.
questions.explanation: The phrase 'wearing blue jerseys' identifies a particular group of players.

questions.question: ___ Bees play an important role in pollination.
questions.explanation: Bees is used in a general statement about the species.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The rivers provide water to many communities.
Rivers provide water to many communities.
A rivers provide water to many communities.
An rivers provide water to many communities.
questions.correctAnswer: Rivers provide water to many communities.
questions.explanation: Rivers is a plural noun used generally, so it takes no article.

questions.question: ___ Doctors often work long hours.
questions.explanation: Doctors refers to the profession as a general group.

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'the' correctly?
options: The birds sitting on our balcony are noisy.
Birds sitting on our balcony are noisy in every context.
questions.correctAnswer: The birds sitting on our balcony are noisy.
questions.explanation: The phrase 'sitting on our balcony' identifies particular birds.

questions.question: ___ Libraries provide access to books and information.
questions.explanation: Libraries refers to libraries as a general category.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The farmers depend on weather conditions.
A farmers depend on weather conditions.
An farmers depend on weather conditions.
questions.explanation: Farmers is a plural noun used generally, so no article is required.

questions.question: ___ Mountains influence the climate of nearby regions.
questions.explanation: Mountains is used generally to refer to mountains as a class.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The mobile phones are becoming more advanced every year.
Mobile phones are becoming more advanced every year.
A mobile phones are becoming more advanced every year.
An mobile phones are becoming more advanced every year.
questions.correctAnswer: Mobile phones are becoming more advanced every year.
questions.explanation: Mobile phones refers to the general category, not a particular set.

questions.question: ___ People need clean drinking water to survive.
questions.explanation: People is used in a general sense, so it does not need an article.
